landing.intro: Mova gives independent stylists one booking page, one QR code and one client list that move with you, from your suite to the salon chair and wherever you go next.
landing.fine: Free to join. Built for booth renters, suite owners and commission stylists.
landing.problemTitle: Your clients are loyal to you. Your tools are loyal to the building.
landing.statCaption: of US salon-goers say they would follow their favorite stylist to a new location.
landing.problem1Title: Your book lives in someone else's system
landing.problem1Body: Change salons and the formulas, notes and visit history stay behind with the front desk.
landing.problem2Body: Prices, deposits, "are you at the suite this week?" Answered between clients, or at 11 p.m.
landing.problem3Body: A late cancel on a Friday is lost income unless someone fills the chair, fast.
landing.howTitle: Set up in minutes. Booked from a scan.
landing.step1Body: Add a photo clients recognize, your services and deposits, and every place you work.
landing.step2Body: Clients scan, pick a day and see where you are. Instant booking at your suite. Requests at the salon, clearly labelled.
landing.step3Body: Reminders, filled cancellations and answers to routine questions. You approve what matters.
landing.campaignBody: When a client cancels, Mova finds the regulars who are due, drafts a text and sends it in small waves once you approve. First to book gets the spot. Everyone else gets a polite "just taken."
landing.campaign1: Approve each text, or let rules you set do it
landing.campaign2: Rebooking reminders that stop when a client books or opts out
landing.campaign3: Win-back messages you send yourself, never on autopilot
landing.conciergeBody: Your assistant replies to texts, missed calls and your booking page, in English or Spanish. It books open times at your suite, sends requests for salon times and always says it's AI. Quotes, complaints and anything unusual come straight to you.
landing.notesBody: Formulas, heat limits and "for next time" notes show up before you start. They belong to you, they move with you, and clients never see them.
landing.whoTitle: Built for how you actually work
landing.who1Body: Your clients, your prices and your payouts, in one place you own.
landing.who2Body: Instant booking and deposits wherever you control the calendar.
landing.who3Body: Clients request times at the salon and you confirm, so the front desk stays in charge of its book.
landing.who4Body: One page that knows where you are each day, so clients book the right place.
landing.rulesBody: Software for stylists should protect the relationship you've built, not cash in on it.
landing.rule1: No Mova fee on cash or salon-collected payments.
landing.rule2: Your client notes are private to you. Always.
landing.rule3: A salon request is never shown as confirmed until you confirm it.
landing.rule4: The AI always says it's AI, and prices always come from you.
landing.rule5: Clients can always book as a guest. No app, no account.
landing.rule6: Texts only go to clients who said yes, and stop when they say stop.
landing.calcBody: Booth rent or commission? Run your numbers in a minute.
landing.guideBody: AI isn't what's making beauty less personal
landing.ctaBody: Set up your page, services and locations in one sitting. Free to start.

features.intro: Mova is one app for your page, bookings, clients, payments and follow-ups. It is built around one fact: your clients follow you, not the building.
features.showcaseBody: Your looks, services, prices and deposits on a page you own. Show your QR code at the chair, on a mirror sticker or in your bio, and clients land on the same page wherever you work.
features.showcase1: Looks and services, with "Book this look"
features.showcase3: Your link moves with you when you change salons
features.bookingBody: Clients pick a day first, then see your times grouped by location. At your suite, they book instantly. At the salon, they send a request and you confirm, so nobody double-books the front desk.
features.booking1: Deposits set per service, only where you collect payment
features.booking2: Requests are always labelled, never shown as confirmed
features.booking3: Manage, reschedule and add-to-calendar links for every client
features.clientsBody: Formulas, products, heat limits and "for next time" notes, with before-and-after photos for each visit. The important bits show up on the appointment before you start.
features.clients1: Notes are private to you; clients never see them
features.clients2: Sensitive notes like allergies are stored encrypted
features.clients3: Import your existing clients from a spreadsheet
features.moneyBody: Send a pay link by text or show a pay QR code your client scans on their own phone. Record cash and other payments in a tap. Money the salon collects is tracked, never charged.
features.money1: No Mova fee on cash or salon-collected payments
features.money3: A monthly view of what you actually take home (an estimate, clearly labelled)
features.revenueBody: Mova learns each client's usual return time and spots open gaps in your week. It drafts the texts; you approve them or set rules once.
features.revenue1: Seat filler: texts the right regulars in small waves and stops when the slot books
features.revenue2: Rebooking reminders on autopilot, only to clients who said yes
features.revenue3: Win-back messages you send yourself, plus a monthly revenue forecast
features.conciergeBody: Your assistant answers texts, missed calls and chat on your page, in English or Spanish. It books open times at your suite and sends requests for salon times. It always says it's AI.
features.concierge1: Quotes, complaints and exceptions always come to you
features.concierge2: Never quotes a price you didn't set or takes payment at the salon
features.concierge3: Turn it off for any conversation, any time
features.clientCardBody: After booking, clients can keep your card on their phone to rebook in one tap, whichever salon you're at. They can book as a guest, or keep one free Mova profile for every stylist they see.
features.clientCard1: Booking confirmations and changes in their language
features.clientCard2: Their own contact choices, per stylist
features.reportsBody: Revenue, bookings, rebook rate, page visits and QR scans, with reviews from verified visits in the same place. Every chart has a table view too.
features.reports1: Reviews only from clients who actually came in
features.reports2: Reply to reviews; nobody can edit what a client wrote
features.reports3: See which channels bring bookings: Instagram, QR, Google, direct
features.ctaBody: Create your account in a few minutes. The Free plan is $0 a month, and you can upgrade any time.

pricing.headlineB: No fee on money Mova doesn't touch.
pricing.intro: Start free. Move up when you want Mova doing more of the work.
pricing.processing: Card processing fees from Stripe are separate. Prices in USD.
pricing.alwaysTitle: On every plan, the fee only applies to money Mova processes
pricing.always3Label: Paid at the salon's front desk
pricing.faq1A: The percentage covers payments that run through Mova, like deposits and pay links. It is never charged on cash you record or on money the salon collects.
pricing.faq2Q: Do my clients pay to book?
pricing.faq3A: Yes. Everyone starts on Free, and you can move to Pro or AI Growth, or back, from Settings whenever you like.
pricing.faq4Q: Not sure if renting a booth makes sense?
pricing.faq4A: Try our free <calc>booth rent vs. commission calculator</calc>. No signup needed.

calculator.intro: Enter a typical week. Your numbers stay in your browser and are never sent to us.
calculator.commissionHint: The share of service revenue the salon keeps on commission.
calculator.rent: Booth or suite rent per week ($)
calculator.expensesHint: Products, tools, booking software and the like, counted in both options.
calculator.errorMissing: Fill in every number to see your results.
calculator.errorCommission: Commission cut must be between 0 and 100%.
calculator.resultsTitle: What you take home per week
calculator.yearly: About {{amount}} a year, if every week looked like this one.
calculator.disclaimer: An estimate, not tax or legal advice. Booth renters usually pay their own self-employment taxes, insurance and supplies; add those to your expenses for a fair comparison.
calculator.nextTitle: Going independent? Take your clients with you.
calculator.nextBody: Mova gives you a booking page, QR code and client notes that move with you.
